 사진 확대 ‘2026 MAMA.’ Photo: Screenshot from Mnet’s YouTube channel The group Longshot won Worldwide Fans’ Choice at the 2026 MAMA AWARDS.
 Chapter 1 of the global flagship K-pop awards ceremony, the 2026 MAMA AWARDS, was held at Kyocera Dome Osaka in Japan at 6 p.m. on the 20th.
 Taking the stage right after receiving the award, Longshot said, “We’re very happy to receive such a wonderful award. This is our first time at MAMA, and we’re grateful to our fans who always support us, our CEO, and our parents. Next year, too, we’ll make music people can relate to, and we’ll show you many more wonderful sides of ourselves going forward.”
 The concept of the 2026 MAMA AWARDS is ‘A MUSIC INTERSTELLAR.’ It depicts a journey across the boundaries of time and space, generations, and tastes, drifting among the stars of music to discover and share music from different eras. The ceremony is being livestreamed around the world in real time through major digital platforms, including Mnet Plus.
 [Lee Da-gyeom, Star Today reporter]
